name: SpS-NeRF
definition: A NeRF variant adapted for sparse single-date satellite images that employs dense depth supervision guided by a cross-correlation similarity metric from traditional semi-global MVS (SGM) matching.
summary: SpS-NeRF is a NeRF variant for sparse satellite imagery that uses traditional semi-global matching depth supervision to enable novel view generation and 3D reconstruction without ground truth depth maps.
